map.按探方或采样单元统计单位面积内出土遗物件数，计算遗物密度以对比各层位与文化堆积的: Count artifacts per unit area by test pit or sampling unit to compute artifact density and compare how rich the layers and cultural deposits are, supporting excavation records.
map.对比不同层位或探方的堆积丰富程度：用出土件数除以发掘面积得到遗物密度（件/m²）: Compare how rich the deposits of different layers or test pits are: divide the artifact count by the excavated area to get artifact density (items/m²) — denser layers were usually more active or thicker.
map.标准化采样：当各探方发掘面积不一致时，必须换算成单位面积密度再比较，不能直接比件: Standardized sampling: when excavated areas differ between test pits you must convert to density per unit area before comparing, rather than comparing raw counts.
map.结合密度异常区定位灰坑、房址等活动面：局部密度突增往往指向废弃堆积或特定功能区域: Use density anomalies to locate ash pits, house floors, and other activity surfaces: a sudden local density spike usually points to a dumped deposit or a zone with a specific function.
map.：探方 T0503 第③层发掘面积 25 m² 出土陶片 150 件，密度=15: : in test pit T0503, layer ③ has an excavated area of 25 m² with 150 sherds, so density = 150/25 = 6.0 items/m²; layer ④ has 25 m² with 40 finds, so density = 1.6 items/m². Layer ③ is about 3.75 times denser, indicating more intense activity or a richer deposit.
map.遗物密度低就代表不重要的层位吗？: Does a Low Artifact Density Mean an Unimportant Layer?
map.不一定。密度受保存条件、耕扰、发掘面积与筛选方式（是否浮选、过筛孔径）影响。低密: Not necessarily. Density depends on preservation conditions, cultivation disturbance, excavated area, and recovery method (whether flotation was used, the mesh size). A low-density layer might be a later-destroyed living surface, or small finds lost because flotation was skipped, so you must read the deposit character alongside it.
map.为什么有的报告用块/立方米？: Why Do Some Reports Use Pieces per Cubic Meter?
map.对于柱坑、灰坑等三维堆积，除平面密度（件/m²）外还会用体积密度（件/m³）描述: For three-dimensional deposits such as post holes and ash pits, volumetric density (items/m³) is used alongside areal density (items/m²). The units differ, so always state the denominator (area or volume) when citing them, or they cannot be compared.
